description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the gate shrine: a small chapel of grey stone and dark timber with a little wooden shingle roof, a carved wooden figure inside, a candle with a bright steady flame, wildflowers and small offerings at its foot
